info.title: pw-dev remote broker API
info.description: Provision a pw-dev CDP broker on a remote Linux or Windows host through SSH, then expose its loopback-only port through a local forward owned by this server. Platform defaults to auto-detection. The remote checkout defaults to ~/.pw-dev/pw-dev and the local forward automatically selects an available port in 18080-18089.

200.description: Active local forwards and their usable broker URLs

post.summary: Provision a remote broker and create a local SSH forward
post.description: Uses the caller's normal OpenSSH authentication. The server clones the repository only when the remote worktree is missing, starts a loopback-only standby broker if one is not already healthy, then waits for the local forward to answer /_broker/status.

target.description: SSH host or user@host accepted by OpenSSH.

hostId.description: Stored remote-host asset ID. Resolves target and SSH identity.

worktree.description: Absolute remote path or path relative to the remote user's home directory.

revision.description: Git revision to run remotely. Defaults to the local pw-dev server checkout's current HEAD.

localPort.description: Optional local forward port; otherwise choose an available port in this range.

platform.description: Remote operating system. Defaults to SSH-based detection; use an explicit value only when detection is unavailable.

201.description: Remote broker is ready and reachable through remoteBroker.brokerUrl.

409.description: The requested id already has a forward, or no local broker port is available.

502.description: SSH setup, remote clone/startup, or local-forward verification failed.

delete.summary: Release a server-owned local SSH forward
delete.description: Stops the owned local SSH forward. Linux remote broker processes and checkouts remain in place; the foreground Windows broker exits with its SSH channel.

post.summary: Release a server-owned local SSH forward
post.description: Alias for DELETE. Linux remote brokers remain running; the foreground Windows broker exits with its owned SSH channel.
Releases the local forward, then verifies the remote pid belongs to the managed pw-dev broker before sending SIGTERM. A broker without the managed pid file is not stopped.

200.description: Forward released and remote broker stopped.

409.description: The remote broker is not safely identifiable as pw-dev-managed.
